```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## High-Resolution Global Mass Coral Bleaching Dataset V2.0 (`zenodo.org/records/6780843`)

```{r}
# Read Zenodo 6780843 (Urcelay & Donner V2.0)
zenodo_data <- read_csv("data/zenodo_6780843.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(LATITUDE), !is.na(LONGITUDE),
    !is.na(OCEAN_REGION)
  )

zenodo_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE, color = OCEAN_REGION)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Global Coral Reefs by Ocean Region",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a surveyed coral reef site colored by its ocean region",
    x = "Longitude (°E / °W)",
    y = "Latitude (°N / °S)",
    color = "Ocean Region",
    caption = "Source: Urcelay & Donner V2.0 (https://zenodo.org/records/6780843)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)))
```

```{r}
# Plot heat/thermal stress (y-axis) vs. amount of bleaching (x-axis)
zenodo_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(PCT_BLEACHED), PCT_BLEACHED >= 0, PCT_BLEACHED <= 100,
    !is.na(CRW_DHW), CRW_DHW >= 0, CRW_DHW <= 25
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PCT_BLEACHED, y = CRW_DHW, color = OCEAN_REGION)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "gam", color = "#b30000", linewidth = 1.1, se = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Heat Stress vs. Amount of Coral Bleaching",
    subtitle = "Higher heat accumulation (Degree Heating Weeks) corresponds to greater coral bleaching",
    x = "Amount of Bleaching (% of Coral Bleached)",
    y = "Heat Stress (Degree Heating Weeks, °C-weeks)",
    color = "Ocean Region",
    caption = "Source: Urcelay & Donner V2.0 (https://zenodo.org/records/6780843)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)))
```
